context: Evaluates correct usage of the InfiniteCurve class for procedural tunnel position queries. Tests that update() is called each frame, that getPointAtZ/getTangentAtZ/zToLocalT are used for position lookups, and that the curve's sliding window generation is properly leveraged.

checklist.name: InfiniteCurve Instantiation
checklist.description: InfiniteCurve is instantiated correctly (new InfiniteCurve() or new InfiniteCurve(seed)) and stored for reuse across frames

checklist.name: update() Call Pattern
checklist.description: update(cameraZ, velocity) is called with the current camera Z position and velocity to drive curve generation ahead of the camera

checklist.name: getPointAtZ() Usage
checklist.description: getPointAtZ(z) is used to retrieve a THREE.Vector3 world position at an absolute Z coordinate within the curve

checklist.name: getTangentAtZ() Usage
checklist.description: getTangentAtZ(z) is used to retrieve a normalized direction vector at an absolute Z coordinate

checklist.name: zToLocalT() / Bounds Usage
checklist.description: zToLocalT(z) is used to convert absolute Z to a 0-1 curve parameter, and getMinZ()/getMaxZ() are consulted for bounds checking
